rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the order in which things follow one another.

example.english: The sequence for appearing on stage has already been arranged.
example.jyutping: ceot1 coeng4 ci3 zeoi6 ji5 ging1 paai4 hou2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a series of related items considered as an ordered set rather than for the order itself.

example.english: This sequence tells one continuous story.
example.traditional: 呢個系列講同一個故事。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 lit6 gong2 tung4 jat1 go3 gu3 si6

rows.note: Use this technical term for a mathematically indexed sequence of numbers or objects.

example.english: Every term in this sequence is the previous term plus two.
example.traditional: 呢個數列嘅每一項都係前一項加二。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sou3 lit6 ge3 mui5 jat1 hong6 dou1 hai6 cin4 jat1 hong6 gaa1 ji6

rows.note: Use this in film or video discussions for a group of shots forming one continuous action or stylistic unit.

example.english: The director used a sequence of shots to film the whole car chase.
example.traditional: 導演用一組鏡頭拍晒成段追車戲。
example.jyutping: dou6 jin2 jung6 jat1 zou2 geng3 tau4 paak3 saai3 sing4 dyun6 zeoi1 ce1 hei3
